commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; echo "RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID"; echo "RUN_ATTEMPT=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; echo "DEVFLOW_APP_ID=${DEVFLOW_APP_ID:-<empty>}"; echo "SERVER=$GITHUB_SERVER_URL"; echo "REPO=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---status---"; git status --porcelain; echo "---git-dirs---"; git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir; git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir

DEVFLOW_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
if .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/preflight.py ignore-precondition --path "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1501.md"; then
  mkdir -p "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body"
  rm -f "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1501.md"
  gh issue view 1501 --json body --jq '.body' > "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1501.md" \
    || gh issue view 1501 --json body --jq '.body' > "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-b …[per-command-truncated]

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body && rm -f .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1501.md && gh issue view 1501 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1501.md && head -c 60 .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1501.md && echo "" && wc -l .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1501.md
for sub in descriptor claim mark-running finish status; do echo "=== $sub ==="; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/verification-flight.py $sub --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,30p'; done

gh pr ready 1523 && echo "PR_OUTCOME=published" || { [ "$(gh pr view 1523 --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null)" = "false" ] && echo "PR_OUTCOME=published (already non-draft)" || echo "PR_OUTCOME=publish_failed"; }

rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/implement-active-1501" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1501.md" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "cleanup done"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
